int_name: N FRONT ST & W GIRARD AVE

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large elevated transit structure that creates significant shadows and visual obstructions via support pillars. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals exist, the wide roadway and faded markings contribute to a higher-risk environment for vulnerable road users.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Pillars
hazards.description: Large structural support pillars for the elevated track block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the corners.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line and within the intersection area

hazards.name: Deep Shadows/Poor Lighting
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates dark shadows that reduce the visibility of pedestrians, even during daylight hours.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area underneath the elevated structure

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: Crosswalk and lane markings are significantly worn, reducing their effectiveness in guiding traffic and protecting pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway and side street intersections

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install bright, uniform LED lighting attached to the structure to illuminate the sidewalk and crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the pillars.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is heavily impacted by an elevated transit structure, where large steel pillars create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals are present, the wide roadway and structural shadows contribute to a high-risk environment.

hazards.name: Elevated train pillars
hazards.description: Large structural supports block sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide roadway
hazards.description: Multiple travel lanes increase the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars and pillars.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to continental style for better visibility under the shadows of the elevated structure.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure that creates significant visual obstructions with its support pillars. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the complex geometry and deep shadows under the tracks increase risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Structural Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support columns for the elevated train block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection further restrict visibility of pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the travel lane.

interventions.title: Enhanced Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install additional lighting specifically directed at the crosswalk areas to counteract deep shadows cast by the overhead structure.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly impacted by an elevated rail structure and street-level trolley tracks, which create visual obstructions and tripping hazards. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the intersection increases exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Elevated Rail Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated rail line obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and motorists at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the roadway edge and center

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create tripping hazards for pedestrians and can catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct sidewalk extensions at the corners to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the pillars.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.
